purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software system. It processes medical accounting/billing card data (会計カード), reading indexed and sequential files of patient treatment records and producing printed output. It appears to handle inpatient/outpatient billing calculations, insurance combinations, and formatted report generation.

verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled display of comments. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used in Japanese clinics. The COPY count of 0 in mechanical indicators likely reflects that COPY statements reference external .INC files not counted by the tool, yet they are clearly present in the source. The program is a large, mature batch billing report generator.
